subject: Production availability breach — ex-gratia remediation request (Clearway)
messages:
From: Alice Harris <alice@clearway.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T15:12:00Z
Subject: Production outage 06/25-06/26 — request for remediation plan & commercial remedy

Dylan,

We had a significant availability and tail-latency event on 2026-06-25 23:40 UTC through 2026-06-26 03:15 UTC that affected our user traffic routed through APAC. Our metrics show ~4 hours of degraded availability (500/502 errors) and sustained 2–3x p50/p95 latency on generation requests. This impacted our checkout flow and resulted in measurable revenue loss during our peak window.

We've attached a sample of logs and our internal incident timeline. We're asking Redwood for a commercial remediation plan: an itemized credit or billing adjustment and a timeline for root-cause analysis + corrective actions. Our procurement/legal team is expecting a proposal by EOD Tuesday so we can present to the CFO.

What we need from you:
- Proposal for commercial remedy (amount, structure — credit vs. free months)
- ETA for RCA and mitigation plan
- Confirmation of any ongoing risk to our production traffic

If you prefer a quick call, I can make time tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks,
Alice Harris
Head of Platform
Clearway Health
[Attachment: clearway-outage-log-0625-0626.csv (csv)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Harris <alice@clearway.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T17:03:00Z
Subject: RE: Production outage 06/25-06/26 — request for remediation plan & commercial remedy

Alice / team,

First, I'm really sorry — this clearly fell short of our availability expectations. Thank you for the timeline and logs; our on-call already pulled the initial kernel traces and routing snapshots. High level: a cascading autoscaler race during a regional network flapping event allowed a small set of router processes to starve KV cache refreshes which in turn amplified latency under burst. We're drafting a full RCA.

For commercial remediation I propose we offer an "ex-gratia" remediation package that balances customer impact with precedent:
- One-time invoice credit of USD 100,000 OR two months of service credits (whichever the customer prefers)
- Priority implementation of the mitigation patch (region rollout within 72 hours)
- Joint RCA review and a 90-day monitoring plan

I don't have unilateral authority for >$50k credits, so I need exec sign-off. Marissa: can finance approve $100k as a special one-off for Clearway? Vivek / Lauren: please advise on leadership/legal okays for the wording/conditions (we'd like acceptance by Clearway that this is an ex-gratia credit and not admission of contractual breach beyond SLO discussion).

Action items:
- Marissa: credit authorization path + limit
- Vivek: exec approval for ex-gratia amount >$50k
- Lauren: legal note on acceptance language + DocuSign flow

I've attached the draft remedy offer and the initial RCA stub so everyone has context.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft-remedy-offer-0627.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Harris <alice@clearway.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Production outage 06/25-06/26 — request for remediation plan & commercial remedy

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear summary. From a finance standpoint I can approve up to USD 50,000 as a one-time credit without additional sign-off; anything above that needs exec approval. Operationally, offering two months of service credit is equivalent to roughly $78–85k on their expected runrate, so that's in the same ballpark as what you proposed.

My recommendation to keep this quick and to preserve precedent:
- Offer the customer either 1) a $50k immediate credit PLUS 1 month of service credit, OR 2) a $90k one-time credit (requires Vivek sign-off).
- Condition the credit on: acceptance of the remediation summary within 14 days and a joint RCA review call.

Lauren — legal will need a short ex-gratia letter and a separation clause saying this doesn't alter SLA contract language. Can you draft a 1-pager and also prepare the DocuSign flow if they accept the credit?

Dylan, loop back to Alice with these options; flag which route you'd prefer so we can fast-track approval.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-memo-clearway-0627.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Harris <alice@clearway.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Production outage 06/25-06/26 — request for remediation plan & commercial remedy

Thanks all — I reviewed the timeline and customer impact. Approve the following ex-gratia remediation package for Clearway Health:

- One-time commercial credit of USD 100,000 (applied to the next invoice)
- Two months of service credits (applied after first billing cycle post-acceptance)
- Condition: Clearway sign the ex-gratia acceptance letter acknowledging this resolves commercial impact for this incident and that it does not amend the SLA contract language.

Dylan: proceed to send the offer to Alice with the acceptance letter attached and route the DocuSign to legal@redwood.ai. Lauren, please prepare the one-page acceptance letter and the DocuSign envelope; Marissa, finance to prepare the ledger entries so we can apply the credit when we receive the signed acceptance.

I'll follow up with the customer if there is pushback on the amount. Thanks everyone for the quick work here.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
